purpose: Recover PIT construction after official bulk/API endpoints proved unreliable in GitHub Actions runners.

statcan_bulk.evidence: Two attempts to download/inspect the full real-time tables were terminated while still running.
statcan_bulk.interpretation: This is an extraction-transport problem, not evidence that the official real-time tables are unavailable.

statcan_metadata_api.evidence: getCubeMetadata POST timed out after 60 seconds on the runner.
statcan_metadata_api.interpretation: Do not block the PIT programme on this endpoint.

official_facts: PEEI vintage database stores real-time data as published.
A revision-date dimension records when vintages were published.
Industrial production and unemployment are split into static older vintages through 2020 and regularly updated vintages from 2021 onward.
Vintage rows are stored only when the published series changes or a new observation appears.
eurostat.extraction_note: Generic SDMX dataflow discovery returned no candidate rows; direct source-specific vintage extraction remains required.

revised_execution_strategy.method: Reconstruct first-release values from dated Statistics Canada The Daily releases at monthly checkpoints, using table 36-10-0491-01 as the real-time validation reference.
revised_execution_strategy.reason: Dated releases are official, individually small, and directly record the values/growth seen by the market.

revised_execution_strategy.method: Use Eurostat PEEI vintage tables directly; preserve revision-date dimension and changing euro-area composition.
revised_execution_strategy.reason: Eurostat explicitly designed these vintages for real-time/revision analysis.

revised_execution_strategy.method: Use dated Statistics Canada monthly retail releases and archived real-time table 20-10-0082-01; exact volume-series continuity must be matched before ingestion.
revised_execution_strategy.reason: Archived table is confirmed real-time and seasonally adjusted; runtime concept match still requires audit.

rules: No use of today's revised value as a substitute for first release.
At each historical checkpoint include only information publicly released by that date.
If a release cannot be recovered, mark WITHHELD_PIT.
Do not change engine thresholds during PIT construction.

gate.next_deliverable: Build a dated-release PIT panel for CAD GDP first, then run the frozen sensitivity harness on that complete series.
